_comment: IV self-tracking for the options-automation sleeve (HARD RULE 8 / routine v3). One row per ticker per day: {date, spot, atm_iv, dte_used, rv_30d, iv_rv_ratio}. atm_iv = average of call+put IV at the strike closest to spot, at the expiry nearest 30 DTE (or the position's actual expiry when tracking an open position's own contract). rv_30d = annualized stdev of daily log returns over the trailing 30 sessions, computed from Robinhood daily historicals. iv_rv_ratio = atm_iv / rv_30d. Bootstrapped 2026-08-11 (first run under routine prompt v3 -- this file did not exist before). With <20 readings for a name, gate entries on iv_rv_ratio alone (>1.5 = elevated premium, prefer legged debit spread or skip + size down); at 20+ readings also compute IV percentile (share of readings below current) per the routine spec.

CVS._note: open agentic position (2026-09-18 100C); tracked because it's under active management
